The Fluke 789 ProcessMeter™ combines a multimeter and loop calibrator designed for instrumentation and electrical professionals.


It offers CAT III 1,000 V / CAT IV 600 V safety ratings, milliamp sourcing/simulation, and 24 V loop power—all in a single compact unit. Perfect for dual-craft workers handling both high-energy circuits and process instrumentation, the 789 ProcessMeter™ simplifies testing, powering, and troubleshooting in the field.


Watch this short video to learn more.


***This video was previously featured on***[Fluke's YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c2xt7zuHD64&t=15s) ***.***
